Prizes were presented to the placed men in the 880 yard handicap (which attracted sixty entries from members of the two clubs and was won by N. Isaacs, with "Snake" Webb second, and E. Stimpson third) and a speech of welcome was made and seconded—by none other than Percy Wright.

"Mick" Walker and "Snaky" Webb, whose dancing reputations are far-flung, should play opposite one another, more often. Ring, the Ruthless, gave a great exhibition of Eastern passion in contrast to his partner, Cecil Penny, who danced with utter abandon.
